source.title: Appointment of a New Senior Delegate - Latin America (April 2019)
source.content:
As a result of our recent application period, a new Senior Delegate has been appointed. For the Latin America region, the Board received the applications of Natán Riggenbach and José Garrido. After deliberation, they decided to appoint Natán Riggenbach for the position.

The appointment is effective immediately. You may find both applications [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1BeB9QbpXIrYk-4E6WCFejrtlbwb93QM6).

We want to thank both applicants for their willingness in helping the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than they currently do now. Good luck to Natán in his new role!

translation.title: 拉丁美洲高级代表任命公告（2019 年 4 月）
translation.content:
近期招募结束后，新一位高级代表已获任命。董事会收到 Natán Riggenbach 和 José Garrido 对拉丁美洲高级代表岗位的申请，经过讨论，决定任命 Natán Riggenbach。

任命即日起生效。两人的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1BeB9QbpXIrYk-4E6WCFejrtlbwb93QM6)查看。

感谢两位申请人愿意在已有工作之外，为 WCA 和速拧社区承担更多责任。祝 Natán 履新顺利！
